exit_code_semantics.note: the outer PowerShell wrapper of B-product-run exits with the child's rc, so the runner's verdict is not masked by the shell
exit_code_semantics.runner: 0 = pass, 1 = harness error, 2 = no verdict (expectation missing or not faithful), 3 = negative case not rejected as expected; precedence 1 > 2 > 3
exit_code_semantics.units: 0 = the unit completed as expected; a non-zero unit rc is recorded verbatim in raw_rc with its reason and is never presented as a pass
